newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Beneficiaries should have to get rid of mines.
newsitem.headline: Beneficiaries should have to get rid of mines.

text.p: European Union development ministers said on Friday research aid to fund anti-landmine projects should only be given to countries which cease further use of landmines and take steps to cease the trade, manufacture and stockpile of them.
They would also have to undertake to support the proposed mine clearance operations and guarantee a minimum level of security.

The objective should be to eliminate the whole range of landmine-related problems, which include not only casualties, but also drains on economic activity and problems in reintegrating refugees and displaced people.
